batchIdentityNotes.note: Imported 700 to 1100. World700 eastern steppe; world900 bbox26.94 to36.50E remains east after settlement, publicly flagged. World1000 encompasses Carpathian Basin. No claim of exact ethnic frontier or founding700. Distinct from existing Hungary state card. Tihany original charter is later than conquest but within imported coverage.

Imported1650to1715 snapshots cover historic Franche-Comté, bbox5.625to6.943E46.175to48.026N. Public narrative distinguishes pre1674 Habsburg county from French province and modern larger region. Do not treat1715 as independence-ending date. Archival daily facts attributed to inventory of precisely dated1686 entries; Latin is scholarly transcription of gate installed1703, now copy.
